hero.line: Jewelry by Mathis Mortier d’Aumont. Sterling silver rings inspired by texture in the nature.
hero.image_alt: Four faceted sterling silver rings standing in a row

about.title: The Jeweler
about.lead: Passionate about manual work, I graduated in 2023. Since then, i developed a strong interest in innovative techniques and technical challenges.
paragraphs: I enjoy working with my hands, exploring traditional techniques and finding new ways to combine them with contemporary design.
I am looking for a position as a goldsmith or bench jeweler in Amsterdam, to develop my skills and contribute to a creative studio or workshop.
skills: Working with silver, gold and other metals

process.title: From observation to form
process.intro: Ideas often start with nature, a texture or a feeling. I sketch, explore materials and test different shapes before moving to the final piece.

techniques.title: Materials and techniques
techniques.intro: I work with traditional hand tools and techniques, while staying open to new methods and materials. Each step is part of the creative and technical process.

workshop.title: Workshop
workshop.text: My workspace is where ideas become real. I have been travelling for the past four years to learn new techniques and traditional knowledge. Experiencing different setups has given me a clear picture of how I want my own workshop.
workshop.image_alt: Mathis Mortier d’Aumont with an Indonesian jeweler in her workshop, in front of the benches and tool boards

goals.title: Amsterdam
paragraphs: Amsterdam is a city that values craftsmanship, creativity and diversity.
I want to join a studio where I can learn from experienced goldsmiths, work on meaningful projects and be part of a community that shares the same passion for jewelry and design.
list: Find effective and creative solutions to complex jewelry-making problems
Expand my knowledge by working alongside skilled goldsmiths
Develop my own style while respecting the identity and vision of the brand

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.intro: A question about a piece, a position in your studio, an idea to share? Write to me, I answer personally.

footer.note: All pieces shown are made in the workshop.

seo.title: Mortier — Mathis Mortier d’Aumont, jeweler
seo.description: Mortier is the work of Mathis Mortier d’Aumont, goldsmith and bench jeweler. One-off pieces in sterling silver, built on a geometric aesthetic drawn from nature.
